name: usaaf-star-bar
about: USAAF national insignia, September 1943 to January 1947: white star on an insignia-blue disc, white bars, the whole outlined in blue. Picture units: the disc has radius 0.5 (size = the disc's diameter). Proportions per the wartime spec: bar length = disc radius each side, bar height = half the radius, blue border 1/8 radius.
